name: Luka Sanguis
source:
A very handsome young man who is apathetic to most things even though he possesses something close to a genius-level intellect. 

[spoiler] He is the other half of God. His nature was fundamentally changed after Myra imparted half of her life force into Luka when he was younger. [/spoiler]
